paragraphs.text: Many experts believe that homework in primary school has little academic value. Reviews of research have found only a weak link between homework and achievement for children under eleven, although the link is stronger for older students. I would not go so far as to abolish it, however. Short, well-designed tasks, such as reading with a parent, can build useful habits. What schools should avoid is setting large amounts of work simply because parents expect it.

groups.instructions: Do the statements agree with the **views of the writer**? Choose **YES**, **NO** or **NOT GIVEN**.
groups.tip: "Many experts believe" uzmanların görüşü; yazarın görüşü "I would not…", "schools should…" gibi ifadelerde.
